questions.question_markdown:
16. （15分）如图，在平行六面体 $ABCD-A_1B_1C_1D_1$ 中，$E$，$F$ 分别为棱 $A_1D_1$，$CD$ 的中点，满足 $\angle B_1BC=\angle B_1BA=\frac{\pi}{3}$，$\angle CBA=\frac{\pi}{2}$，$|AB|=|BC|=2$，$|BB_1|=3$。
<插图>
(1) 求证：$EF\parallel$ 平面 $BDA_1$；
(2) 求 $BD_1$ 的长度；
(3) 求 $AC$ 与 $EF$ 夹角的余弦值。

printed_anchors: typeset italic labels A_1, B_1, C_1, D_1, E, D
uniform solid parallelepiped edge line work with printed dashed hidden edges
handwriting_features: red pen overlays tracing BD, AC and other segments
handwritten pi/3 and 2 labels near vertex B
green shading smudges inside the solid
handwritten reinforcement of labels A, B, C, F
figure_observations.observed_features: A printed parallelepiped skeleton with typeset top-face labels remains clearly visible beneath heavy red/green student annotations used in the retained proof; the stem says 'as shown', so it is the printed question figure with handwritten overlay.

handwritten_answer.text:
(1) 如图连接 $A_1B$，$BD$，$A_1E$，设 $BD$ 的中点为 $G$，连接 $A_1G$，$GF$
$\because$ 这是一个平行六面体
$\because A_1D_1\parallel BC$，$G$，$F$ 分别是 $BD$，$CD$ 的中点
$\therefore GF\overset{\parallel}{=}\frac{1}{2}BC$
$\because E$ 是 $A_1D_1$ 的中点，$\therefore A_1E\overset{\parallel}{=}\frac{1}{2}BC$，$\therefore A_1E\overset{\parallel}{=}GF$
$\therefore$ 四边形 $A_1EGF$ 为平行四边形，$\therefore A_1G\parallel EF$
$\because EF\not\subset$ 平面 $BDA_1$，$A_1G\subset$ 平面 $BDA_1$，$\therefore EF\parallel$ 平面 $BDA_1$
(2) $\overrightarrow{BD_1}=\overrightarrow{BA}+\overrightarrow{BC}+\overrightarrow{BB_1}$
$\overrightarrow{BD_1}^2=\overrightarrow{BA}^2+\overrightarrow{BC}^2+\overrightarrow{BB_1}^2+2\overrightarrow{BA}\cdot\overrightarrow{BC}+2\overrightarrow{BA}\cdot\overrightarrow{BB_1}+2\overrightarrow{BC}\cdot\overrightarrow{BB_1}$
$=4+4+9+0+2\times2\times3\times\frac{1}{2}\times2=29$
(3) $\overrightarrow{AC}=\overrightarrow{BC}-\overrightarrow{BA}$，$\overrightarrow{EF}=\frac{1}{2}\overrightarrow{BA}+\frac{\overrightarrow{BC}}{2}-\overrightarrow{BB_1}$
$|\overrightarrow{AC}|=2\sqrt{2}$，$|\overrightarrow{EF}|=\sqrt{11}$
$|\overrightarrow{AC}\cdot\overrightarrow{EF}|=4$
$\frac{\sqrt{22}}{11}$
handwritten_answer.evidence_note: Red retained handwriting matches the draft line by line: construction of G and A_1G, GF parallel-and-equal 1/2 BC via the double-stroke-over-equals mark, vector expansion of BD1, '=4+4+9+0+2×2×3×1/2×2=29', |EF|=√11, |AC·EF|=4 followed by a crossed-out attempt and the retained final √22/11.

page_notes: A stray black fraction reading like 3/36 sits in the right margin between Q15 and Q16; its ownership is unresolved and it was not attached to Q15. The red handwriting overlapping the Q15 area belongs to Q16's solution.
